info.name: Inji Verify - Issuer Verification (QA)
info.description: QA collection for issuer verification on tag v0.17.0. Read QA-HANDOVER.md first. Each request states the server profile it needs; folders 2-4 need the service restarted with a different registry fixture/profile between runs.

request.description: Existing behaviour. With the feature disabled the response must be exactly {verificationStatus} (no issuerVerification key).

Signature invalid. issuerVerification must be ABSENT in every profile: forged input must never trigger DID or registry lookups. Also confirm in the server log/network that no outbound request was made.
Existing behaviour: 400.
Explicit opt-out wins over run-by-default.
Explicit opt-in. Requires feature enabled. Any registry profile.
Non-boolean value. Spring returns 400.

item.name: 6. /v2/vc-verification (v0.17.0)
item.description: Needs the environment variable vc_valid_json_string = vc_valid encoded as a JSON string (escaped quotes), because /v2 takes the credential as a string field. Same server profiles as folders 1-4.

exec: // With run-by-default=false (or feature disabled) there must be no issuerVerification key.

request.description: Existing v2 behaviour; issuerVerification appears only when the server default runs it.
Explicit opt-in. Requires the feature enabled.
Request flag overrides run-by-default.
Needs profile enforce=true with a suspended/revoked issuer fixture (same as 4.2). Signature checks in the response stay valid; only allChecksSuccessful changes.

exec: pm.test("issuer check NOT run for an invalid signature", () => pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("issuerVerification"));

request.description: Issuer verification must not run (no outbound DID/registry requests) for a credential whose signature is invalid.
